questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "ABANDON"
questions.explanation: ABANDON का अर्थ होता है छोड़ना या त्यागना। Synonym: Forsake, Desert, Relinquish.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "ABANDON"
questions.explanation: ABANDON का अर्थ त्यागना है, अतः इसका Antonym है Retain (बनाए रखना) या Keep.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "CANDID"
questions.explanation: CANDID का अर्थ होता है स्पष्टवादी, निष्कपट या ईमानदार। Synonym: Frank, Honest, Outspoken.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "CANDID"
questions.explanation: CANDID (स्पष्टवादी) का विलोम Deceitful (धोखेबाज़) या Secretive (छिपाने वाला) होता है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "DILIGENT"
questions.explanation: DILIGENT का अर्थ होता है परिश्रम करने वाला या मेधावी। Synonym: Hardworking, Assiduous, Industrious.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "DILIGENT"
questions.explanation: DILIGENT (मेहनती) का Antonym है Lazy (आलसी) या Idle.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "FRUGAL"
questions.explanation: FRUGAL का अर्थ होता है किफायती या कम खर्च करने वाला। Synonym: Thrifty, Economical, Economiser.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "FRUGAL"
questions.explanation: FRUGAL (मितव्ययी) का Antonym है Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च करने वाला) या Wasteful.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who looks at the bright/positive side of things"
questions.explanation: आशावादी व्यक्ति को Optimist कहते हैं (Pessimist = निराशावादी)।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who looks at the dark/negative side of things"
questions.explanation: हर चीज़ का नकारात्मक पहलू देखने वाले निराशावादी व्यक्ति को Pessimist कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A person who does not believe in the existence of God"
questions.explanation: ईश्वर में विश्वास न रखने वाले नास्तिक को Atheist कहते हैं (Theist = आस्तिक)।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A life history of a person written by himself"
questions.explanation: स्वयं द्वारा लिखी गई अपनी जीवन कथा को Autobiography (आत्मकथा) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A life history of a person written by another person"
questions.explanation: किसी अन्य व्यक्ति द्वारा लिखी गई जीवनी को Biography कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "To bite the bullet"
options: To face a difficult situation courageously
To get shot in a war
questions.explanation: To bite the bullet = किसी कठिन या अवांछित परिस्थिति का साहसपूर्वक सामना करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Break the ice"
options: To start a conversation in a silent/awkward situation
questions.explanation: Break the ice = चुप्पी तोड़ना, बातचीत शुरू करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Burn the midnight oil"
options: To sleep late in the morning
To work or study late into the night
questions.explanation: Burn the midnight oil = देर रात तक पढ़ाई या काम करना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Once in a blue moon"
questions.explanation: Once in a blue moon = ईद का चाँद होना, बहुत दुर्लभ अवसर पर।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Spill the beans"
options: To drop food on the floor
questions.explanation: Spill the beans = भेद या गुप्त बात उजागर कर देना।

questions.question: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical ERROR: "He is one of the best student in our class."
questions.explanation: Rule: 'One of the' के बाद प्लुरल नाउन (Plural Noun) आता है, अतः 'student' के स्थान पर 'students' होगा।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "Neither Ram nor his friends is present today."
questions.explanation: Rule: Neither...nor में वर्ब निकटतम सबजेक्ट के अनुसार आती है; 'his friends' प्लुरल है, अतः 'are' आएगा।

questions.question: Identify the segment with an ERROR: "She has been working here since five years."
questions.explanation: Rule: अनिश्चित समय/अवधि (Duration) के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग होता है, अतः 'since' के स्थान पर 'for five years' होगा।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "He is senior _____ me in service."
questions.explanation: Rule: Senior, Junior, Superior, Inferior, Prior, Preferable आदि शब्दों के साथ 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "She prefers tea _____ coffee."
questions.explanation: Rule: Verb 'Prefer' और 'Preferable' के साथ हमेशा 'to' प्रपोजिशन का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition: "The cat jumped _____ the table."
questions.explanation: Rule: गति (Motion in direction) के साथ किसी सतह पर कूदने/जाने के लिए 'upon' या 'onto' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the CORRECTLY spelt word:
questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी ACCOMMODATE (double C, double M) है, जिसका अर्थ ठहराना/स्थान देना होता है।

questions.question: Select the CORRECTLY spelt word:
questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी EMBARRASS (double R, double S) है, जिसका अर्थ लज्जित करना होता है।

questions.question: Select the CORRECTLY spelt word:
questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी OCCURRENCE (double C, double R, ENCE) है, जिसका अर्थ घटना होता है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "OBSTINATE"
questions.explanation: OBSTINATE का अर्थ होता है हठी या जिद्दी। Synonym: Stubborn, Rigid, Refractory.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "OBSTINATE"
questions.explanation: OBSTINATE (जिद्दी) का Antonym है Flexible (लचीला/नम्र) या Yielding.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "TRANSIENT"
questions.explanation: TRANSIENT का अर्थ होता है क्षणिक या अस्थाई। Synonym: Temporary, Ephemeral, Short-lived.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "TRANSIENT"
questions.explanation: TRANSIENT (क्षणिक) का Antonym है Permanent (स्थाई) या Eternal.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Government by a single ruler with absolute unlimited power"
questions.explanation: एक ही व्यक्ति द्वारा निरंकुश शासन व्यवस्था को Autocracy (एकतंत्र/तानाशाही) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Government by the wealthy and rich class of people"
questions.explanation: धनी वर्ग के लोगों द्वारा चलाई जाने वाली सरकार को Plutocracy (धनिकतंत्र) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Government by civil officials or bureaucrats"
questions.explanation: सरकारी नौकरशाहों/अफसरों के शासन को Bureaucracy (नौकरशाही) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "Handwriting or printing that is impossible to read"
questions.explanation: जो लिखावट पढ़ी न जा सके उसे Illegible (अपठनीय) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Apple of one's eye"
questions.explanation: Apple of one's eye = आँख का तारा, अत्यधिक प्यारा।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "Beat around the bush"
options: Avoid coming to the main point
To hit bushes with a stick
questions.explanation: Beat around the bush = घुमा-फिराकर बात करना, मुख्य बिंदु से भटकना।

questions.question: Select the correct meaning of the IDIOM: "A blessing in disguise"
options: A lucky event that turns bad
A curse from a holy person
An apparent misfortune that yields a good result
questions.explanation: A blessing in disguise = आपदा में अवसर/छिपा हुआ वरदान।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "If I <u>was</u> a king, I would help the poor."
questions.explanation: Rule: काल्पनिक शर्त (Unreal Conditional Sentence) में सब्जेक्ट के साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the correct improvement for the underlined part: "Hardly had I reached the station <u>than</u> the train left."
questions.explanation: Rule: Hardly / Scarcely के साथ कंजंक्शन के रूप में सदैव 'when' या 'before' आता है, 'than' नहीं।

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "He wrote a letter."
options: A letter is written by him.
A letter was being written by him.
A letter was written by him.
A letter has been written by him.
questions.explanation: Past Simple Tense (Subject + V2 + Object) का Passive = Object + was/were + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into PASSIVE VOICE: "She is cooking food."
options: Food is being cooked by her.
Food has been cooked by her.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous Tense (is/am/are + V-ing) का Passive = Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject.

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: He said, "I am going to market."
options: He told that he is going to market.
He asked if he was going to market.
He said that he was going to market.
He said that I am going to market.
questions.explanation: Reporting verb Past Tense में होने से Present Continuous (am going) बदलकर Past Continuous (was going) बनेगा।

questions.question: Change into INDIRECT SPEECH: She said to me, "What is your name?"
options: She asked me what my name was.
She asked me what is my name.
She asked me what was my name.
She told me what my name is.
questions.explanation: WH- प्रश्न में reporting verb 'asked' बनेगी, WH-word कंजंक्शन बनेगा तथा प्रश्न साधारण वाक्य (what my name was) बन जाएगा।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the word: "BENEVOLENT"
questions.explanation: BENEVOLENT का अर्थ होता है परोपकारी, दयालु या उदार। Synonym: Kind, Generous, Altruistic.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word: "BENEVOLENT"
questions.explanation: BENEVOLENT (दयालु) का Antonym है Malevolent (द्वेषी/दुष्ट) या Cruel.

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "That which cannot be satisfied or appeased"
questions.explanation: जिसकी तृप्ति/संतुष्टि न हो सके उसे Insatiable (अतृप्त) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A place where birds are kept and reared"
questions.explanation: पक्षियों को रखने के स्थान/पिंजरे को Aviary कहते हैं (मधुमक्खियों का स्थान Apiary होता है)।

questions.question: Select the ONE WORD for: "A place where bees are kept and hives are maintained"
questions.explanation: मधुमक्खियों के पालन/पालतू डिब्बों के स्थान को Apiary कहते हैं।

questions.explanation: सही वर्तनी NEIGHBOUR (पड़ोसी) है।
